notes.title: RoundZ - Update 0.4.0
notes.notes: [p]Hey survivors,[/p][p]Patch 0.4.0 is live! This time, it’s all about accessibility. RoundZ now supports [b]seven new languages[/b], making it easier than ever to dive into the undead madness, no matter where you're from.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌐 [b]New Languages Now Available:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Español[/p][/*][*][p]Français[/p][/*][*][p]Deutsch[/p][/*][*][p]Русский[/p][/*][*][p]Português[/p][/*][*][p]Português (Brasil)[/p][/*][*][p]中文（简体）[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You’ll find full translation support for all interface elements and subtitles. You can change your language preference any time from the settings menu.[/p][p]This update sets the stage for even more players to experience RoundZ fully localized, and it’s just one more step forward.[/p][p]🧪 Coming next: local multiplayer and maybe… a few new secrets hidden around the map.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with the project and giving your feedback. notes.title: RoundZ - Patch 0.3.1 — Save File Migration & Achievement Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hey survivors,[/p][p]Patch 0.3.1 is live and includes a must‑read change for save files, plus improvements to the achievement system.[/p][p][/p][h2]📁 SAVE FILE LOCATION UPDATED - READ THIS FIRST[/h2][p][/p][p]The save folder has been moved to improve data reliability and future compatibility.[/p][p]Old path:[/p][p]D:\\SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\RoundZ\\Saved\\SaveGames[/p][p]New path:[/p][p]C:\\Users\\\[YourName]\\AppData\\Local\\RoundZ\\Saved\\SaveGames[/p][p][b][i]➡️ IMPORTANT: To keep your progress, you must manually move your existing SaveData1.sav from the old folder to the new one. If you don’t, the game will create a new save and your progress will be lost.[/i][/b][/p][p]I apologize for the inconvenience this extra step may cause, but it’s essential to prevent data loss.[/p][p][/p][h2]🏆 ACHIEVEMENT SYSTEM FIXES[/h2][p][/p][p]- Achievements now unlock in real time, without needing to close the game.[/p][p]- Progressive achievements (like kill counts) now track properly during gameplay.[/p][p]- Fixed stat-based achievements that were previously unobtainable.[/p][p]This update ensures your save files and achievements remain intact moving forward.[/p][p]Thank you for all your feedback and support![/p][p][/p][p]— Hugo, developer of RoundZ[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: RoundZ - Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,

Patch 0.3.0 is here bringing one of the most requested features: Steam Achievements. This update adds new objectives and hidden challenges to test your skills and give even more reasons to dive back into RoundZ.

[h2]🏆 Achievements System Added[/h2]

[list]
[*] A total of 31 achievements have been added.
[*] Covering survival, exploration, progression and skill-based challenges.
[*] 8 secret achievements hidden for players to discover.
[*] Achievements unlock automatically based on your current progress.
[/list]

[h2]🔮 What’s Next?[/h2]

Development continues with local multiplayer (split-screen) already in the works, alongside plans to expand the world with new lore elements and environmental storytelling hidden across the map.

Thanks again for all the support, feedback and bug reports that help shape RoundZ with every patch. The journey continues.

– Hugo, developer of RoundZ.

notes.title: RoundZ - Patch 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,

Patch 1.2.0 is here, and it brings one of the most requested features: full controller support. Along with that, I’ve added UI upgrades to improve the gameplay experience and give it a more polished feel.

Here’s what’s included:

[h2]🎮 Controller Support[/h2]

[h3]You can now play RoundZ entirely with a gamepad:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full menu navigation

[*] Complete gameplay control

[*] Aim assist for better zombie targeting

[*] Run toggle: press the joystick once to sprint

[*] UI prompts now switch automatically depending on whether you're using keyboard or gamepad
[/list]

[h2]🧾 UI Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Interaction prompts now relocate automatically when subtitles appear, so everything stays readable and clean.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 Achievements – Coming Soon[/h2]

[h3]Next on the list: Steam achievements.[/h3]
I’m working on a full set to reward progression, secrets, and survival milestones. Some will be straightforward, others a bit more cryptic...

Thanks again for all the support. I’m building this game solo, and every update is a step forward thanks to your feedback. Keep surviving, more updates are already in the works.

– Hugo, developer of RoundZ.

notes.title: RoundZ - Patch 0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked level progression values for a smoother XP curve.
[*] Fixed a bug where Step 1 of the Easter Egg was not interactable.
[*] Fixed a bug where the upgrade machine did not correctly return the upgraded weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue where footstep debug visuals would appear randomly during gameplay.
[*] Fixed collision issues on zombies affected by the Zushi Gun.
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to pick up the knife in Room 1.
[*] Added a Gamma adjustment option in the settings menu.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-lit several interior areas that appeared too dark on "Medium" and "Low" graphic settings for better visibility.
[/list]

notes.title: RoundZ - Patch 0.0.1
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Changes & Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the upgrade machine could leave players without their weapon.
[*] Fixed an issue where zombies could get stuck in the Liberty Wheel from the lab hallway.
[*] Fixed an issue where zombies could get stuck at the first barrier in the second room.
[*] Fixed Radar collision, preventing players from getting on top of it.
[*] Fixed LockRunIn UI, which incorrectly displayed "SprintALot."
[*] Ammo purchase UI now correctly changes from red to white after buying.
[*] Improved zombie pathfinding to reduce unexpected movement changes.
[*] Increased Mac-10 yaw recoil for better weapon balancing.
[*] Stats are now saved when exiting the pause menu.
[/list]
[b][h3]New Features[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added unique names for each upgraded weapon.
[*] Updated UI colors for the name and outline of upgraded weapons.
[/list]
